## Change

Describe the problem and resulting behavior. Link the issue with `Closes #...`.

## Validation

Record relevant tests/checks and acceptance evidence. State whether any live calls were made.

## Rollback

State how to revert the change. For data changes, include schema compatibility, backup/restore steps, and any data loss implications.

## Progress

- [ ] Acceptance criteria met
- [ ] STATUS and CHANGELOG updated where relevant
- [ ] Compatibility/data implications reviewed
- [ ] No credentials, local databases, or build artifacts included
